name: Core Portfolio
when_to_use: The long-term core sleeve: review holdings, dividend health, and overall allocation once a week. Use to keep the buy-and-hold / dividend book healthy and decide deliberate rebalance actions. Operationalized weekly by the core-portfolio-weekly workflow.

name: Dividend Income
when_to_use: Source and underwrite new US-listed dividend candidates once a week with Kanchi's 5-step method: screen for yield and quality, deep-dive the strongest names, and register a fully documented candidate thesis before any entry. Operationalized by the kanchi-dividend-weekly workflow (v1 covers US-listed dividend stocks only).

name: Market Regime
when_to_use: The shared risk layer for every trading day. Use before considering new swing-trade risk to decide today's exposure posture (allow / restrict / cash-priority) from breadth, uptrend participation, and top-risk signals. Operationalized daily by the market-regime-daily workflow.

name: Strategy Research
when_to_use: Research a long-side US equity idea from local historical observations: detect candidate tickets, refine them with hints, and evaluate separately measured backtest results. The strategy-research-pipeline workflow is an offline research path, not an end-to-end backtest runner.

name: Swing Opportunity
when_to_use: The satellite swing sleeve: generate and validate swing-trade candidates and build risk-sized entry plans. Use only on days the market-regime sleeve has allowed new risk. Operationalized by the swing-opportunity-daily workflow (prerequisite: market-regime-daily exposure decision).

name: Trade Memory
when_to_use: The shared learning loop: record closed-trade outcomes, run postmortems, and feed lessons back into the process. Use after every closed position and for the monthly performance retrospective. Operationalized by the trade-memory-loop (per closed trade) and monthly-performance-review (monthly) workflows.
